title: Microsoft AI Gateway - Simply Explained
description:
When every team connects its own AI app straight to a model provider, keys leak, costs blur and nobody can say what an agent actually did. This episode is for platform, security and AI teams scaling beyond a single chatbot. You learn how Microsoft AI Gateway in Azure API Management centralizes routing, identity, safety checks and token limits for models, tools and agents.
In this episode
00:00 – From one chatbot to dozens of AI tools00:56 – One front door for AI03:27 – One endpoint, many models06:53 – Governing agents and tools10:08 – Token costs, limits and visibility13:28 – A simple request journey16:38 – Where to start
Key takeaways
Microsoft AI Gateway is a set of Azure API Management features that puts one managed control point in front of AI models, MCP tools, agents and business APIs.Routing behind a stable endpoint lets platform teams change models, regions or providers and add backup paths without changing every application.Per-agent identities, narrow approved tools, safety checks and token limits and quotas keep agents in bounds and make AI usage and cost traceable.
Worth quoting
“The AI Gateway is the reception desk and the security desk at the front. It checks who is coming in, applies the rules and records where requests go before they reach the rest of the building.” – Mirko Peters (01:21)
“A wrong answer from a model confuses someone, but an agent using the wrong tool can expose data, change a record, or trigger a process it should never touch.” – Mirko Peters (07:22)
Explore more on M365.FM
Episode page: the full episode with chapters, quotes and FAQ on Microsoft AI GatewayAzure API Management – the service whose features make up Microsoft AI Gateway, extended from regular APIs to AI trafficAI agent – the main risk case here, since agents call tools and each should get its own identityModel Context Protocol (MCP) – the tool connection standard whose servers the gateway can put access and safety controls aroundMicrosoft Foundry – where teams build and manage AI projects, while the gateway governs the traffic they createRelated episode: Extending Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agents, MCP & Production-Grade AI with Yves Habersaat [MVP]
